summary: Preserve property writes through the initial exports alias to module.exports.

target.notes: At wrapper entry exports and module.exports reference the same object; reuse ordinary JS property-set semantics.

semantics.operation: ordinary JavaScript Set on that object

caveats: Property keys/accessors/proxies belong to existing OBJECT/OPERATORS semantics.

tests.name: multiple writes share object
tests.input:
// a.cjs: exports.a=1; exports.b=2
